answer: Each challenge is derived from a domain-separated, threshold-BLS-verified future beacon pulse, so its exact inputs remain unpredictable until the pulse is published. A participant commits before the reveal window, then proves work bound to that pulse and commitment; stored solutions or offline farming cannot be prepared for the eventual challenge. This does not forbid creating identities, but makes each Sybil incur fresh, verifiable work, raising the ridge to mass participation.
